segments.name: Agentic commerce
segments.description: Provides an AI-led commerce platform enabling discovery, conversation, checkout, fulfillment and payments for retail and enterprise brands.
segments.evidence: We operate as a single operating segment.

segments.name: Enterprise Services
segments.description: Provides information technology services, intelligent business solutions and analytics to help businesses leverage insights and meet IT needs.
segments.evidence: Our Enterprise Services line of business provides information technology services (primarily on a cost-plus basis), intelligent business solutions and analytics to assist businesses in leveraging insights for strategic decision-making and to fulfill both their local and global information technology needs.

revenueModel.text: Merchants pay primarily subscription or consumption fees for SaaS commerce products, billed monthly, plus cost-plus professional IT services.
revenueModel.evidence: Merchants are billed on a monthly basis for the services rendered.
